headline: North Carolina inflict SMU's only defeat of the season
dek: SMU have lost once in eighteen matches, and it was North Carolina, winning away at SMU, who did it. SMU still head the conference table without a defeat in it.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: SMU's goals come with almost none against: 51 scored and nine conceded, a margin of 42.

wire.line: North Carolina have now beaten Clemson, NC State and SMU in successive matches.
